Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator provided a Python script that assumed the house number in the street address was always the first part of the address (e.g., "123 Main Street"). This assumption may not hold universally if the spreadsheet contains addresses formatted differently (e.g., "Main Street 123" or "Apt 4, 123 Main Street"). This oversight could lead to incorrect parsing of the address and, consequently, an inaccurate count of even-numbered addresses. The Orchestrator should have specified a more robust method to extract the house number or validated the format of the address data in the spreadsheet before proceeding with this logic.
